questions.question: Which description fits the **NutritionOrder** resource?
options: A request to supply a diet, formula feeding (enteral) or oral nutritional supplement to a patient/resident.
This resource includes all the people and organizations who plan to participate in the coordination and delivery of care for a patient.

Describes the intention of how one or more practitioners intend to deliver care for a particular patient, group or community for a period of time, possibly limited to care for a specific condition or set of conditions.
A group of related requests that can be used to capture intended activities that have inter-dependencies such as "give this medication after that one".
questions.explanation: **NutritionOrder**: A request to supply a diet, formula feeding (enteral) or oral nutritional supplement to a patient/resident. The other descriptions belong to **CareTeam**, **CarePlan**, **RequestGroup**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? Order a diabetic diet for an inpatient.
You know **NutritionOrder**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “other orders”?
questions.explanation: **ServiceRequest**: other orders. **NutritionOrder** is for something else: A request to supply a diet, formula feeding (enteral) or oral nutritional supplement to a patient/resident.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **NutritionOrder** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of NutritionOrder are `status` (1..1), `intent` (1..1), `patient` (1..1), `dateTime` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **NutritionOrder** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of NutritionOrder: `status`, `intent`. `status`: draft | active | on-hold | revoked | completed | entered-in-error | unknown. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
